caption.en: The Company board: summary counts, and every task with its status, owner and dependencies. Ready tasks are marked 'can start'; the rest show how many dependencies they wait on.
caption.zh: 公司看板：统计数字，以及每个任务的状态、负责人与依赖。可开始的任务标为 “can start”，其余显示还等几个前置。

caption.en: A workspace with no company OS yet: the panel names the folder and gives a copy button, so bootstrapping it is one paste away.
caption.zh: 尚未建立公司系统的工作区：面板显示资料夹路径并提供复制按钮，执行 bootstrap 只需一次粘贴。

caption.en: The Company board button, always in the sidebar footer.
caption.zh: 公司看板按钮，固定位于侧边栏底部。

caption.en: opc doctor is the health check, opc board is the derived view, opc pack prints the prompt for one task.
caption.zh: opc doctor 是健康检查，opc board 是派生视图，opc pack 印出单个任务的 prompt。
